system.description:
Gained at Level 12.

Cost: 4 Bloodloss (Maximum Health). Requires both hands empty.

Pool blood between both hands and form it into a spiraling lance. This ability requires a connection to your target beyond Sight — roll Arcane Sense; the result determines the range. Select a target within range (even without LoS), then make an attack roll.

This attack can pierce through 1 Space of cover, dealing [3×Soul + Manaburn] damage to your target and any obstruction. If a creature is interrupting LoS against your target, that creature makes an Evasion Check against your Potency — on failure they also suffer the damage.
